findings.reason: the section should name the named ids as a floor ("finds the seven named above among the staging-only reviews it reports") rather than a bare count, since node (1) lands first and further reviews accumulate before node (2)'s census.
findings.text: §13 node (2)'s done-when requires the pre-import census to report "reckon's seven staging-only plan reviews named above", but that count has already grown: a re-run of the census against the host store and the committed tree today finds eight (the five named at v81/v82/v84/v88/v97 plus v100, dispatched 14:28:24 and still staging-only), and every plan review promoted before node (2) runs adds to it — so a node reading the expectation as fixed sees its own census read as wrong.

findings.reason: the node would either build a control narrower than the three it must cover or discover mid-flight that the stated test cannot be written; rewording to "asserts each reader routes its lookup through the accessor" makes the control buildable and still falsifiable.
findings.text: §9(e)'s declared control "patches the accessor to return a sentinel response and finds that sentinel in all three readers' results" is not satisfiable with one sentinel: the three readers surface different things from a response — declined_recurrence returns type→plan counts only when the response action is "declined", _acted_finding_types returns the finding's type set only when the action is "acted", and review_scope returns the action and reason text — so a single response cannot appear in all three results.
